message.content:
This document is a README for **Project Maya**, a system for running large open models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) locally on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Maya quants (XS/S/S24/M/L) are made from released weights and measured against originals: GLM-5.3 keeps 97.7–99.2% of FP8 zero-shot accuracy and matches next-token 83–90% of the time; DeepSeek V
